questions.de: Für welches Amt wurden 1575 in Genua fünf Namen aus einer Liste mit 90 Namen ausgelost?
questions.en: For which office were five names drawn by lot from a list of 90 names in Genoa in 1575?

timeline.labelEn: Genoa's Leges novae: five members of the ruling councils are drawn by lot twice a year, origin of Lotto
timeline.labelDe: Genuas Leges novae: Zweimal jährlich werden fünf Mitglieder der Regierungsräte ausgelost – Ursprung des Lottos

source.title: Gênes et la naissance du loto – Encyclopædia Universalis

questions.notes: Reworked from multiple choice. Sources date the reform 1576 (some 1573/1575) and speak of a senate of 120, later 90, or of the Great Council/Serenissimi Collegi; betting on the draw gave rise to Lotto.

questions.en: What is the name of the German artist whose butter artwork Fettecke (Fat Corner) was thrown away unasked by cleaners in 1986?

timeline.labelEn: Johannes Stüttgen finds Beuys' destroyed Fettecke in a bin at the Düsseldorf Kunstakademie
timeline.labelDe: Johannes Stüttgen findet Beuys’ zerstörte Fettecke in einem Abfalleimer der Düsseldorfer Kunstakademie

questions.notes: Wikipedia says the academy caretaker (Hausmeister) removed it, about nine months after Beuys died; the "cleaners" image comes from the 1973 Leverkusen case where Beuys' bathtub was scrubbed, often confused with it.
